risk_assessment: All 280 last-by-ID stdout usage objects omit both cache fields and report output_tokens=0. No message omits input_tokens or output_tokens; all present numeric values are valid. Earlier assistant emissions have the same missing-cache shape.

Every final result has all four nonnegative finite numeric usage fields; both cache totals and output totals are positive in every row. Missing cache fields cannot be interpreted as zeros. Last-by-ID stdout usage is not complete final accounting.

The strict native collector ignores stdout usage and sums native persisted session messages. These old custom stdout files alone do not establish that native persisted logs have the same incomplete shape. They show a material compatibility risk, not proof that normal-provider persisted accounting will fail.

If actual persisted messages preserve this stdout shape, the frozen collector rejects them. That rejection protects against fabricated zero-cache accounting. The fake-native baseline already proves complete persisted shape is possible when the fixture supplies all four components; it does not prove actual-provider behavior.
